final: WITH g AS (SELECT transref AS id, AVG(anlycount) AS ga FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), o AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.id, g.ga, g.ga - o.oa AS d FROM g JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE g.ga > o.oa), f AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS fa FROM r) SELECT r.id, r.ga, r.d, r.ga - f.fa AS d2 FROM r JOIN f ON f.fa IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d2 DESC LIMIT 10
